system:
You compress serialized-story history for writers who must stay consistent later.
Keep: who did what, what changed, secrets learned and by whom, deaths/injuries/locations, unresolved questions,
promises and threats made. Drop: prose, mood, anything that didn't change the story. Plain factual sentences.

Summarize arc 1 'Six Twelve' in <=250 words:
ep 1: Bhuvan shows Meher a photograph of a body in Aadit’s coat and apparent ring, but says the identification is provisional. Meher then receives a call from a man who sounds like Aadit; he refuses to speak to the police and says he knew they would suspect her.
ep 2: At 6:16, Bhuvan questions Meher about the previous night. Meher writes down times she cannot firmly remember. Shanta then says she found Meher’s room empty at 9:40, and Bhuvan strikes out Meher’s claim that she stayed there until 10:00.
ep 3: Naina calls the number that reached Meher at 6:12. Bus driver Jitendra Rawat confirms that a man borrowed his phone that morning, but cannot identify him. He also reports finding a handkerchief with dark red spots where the man sat at Anardana Dhaba.
ep 4: At Anardana Dhaba, Jitendra confirms that the man who borrowed his phone asked to call Meher by name. Bhuvan collects the spotted handkerchief and finds a grocery slip bearing Meher’s name beneath the bench.
ep 5: Meher asks Bhuvan to examine the body before it is released, admitting that she recognized Aadit’s coat and what looked like his ring in the photograph, but not the face. Bhuvan keeps the identification provisional and refuses Raghav’s request to claim the body before the examination.
ep 6: Meher asks Tara whether she can identify the dawn caller by his voice. Tara did not hear the call and presses Meher on why the caller refused to speak to Bhuvan. Tara also tells Meher about the baby she was told had died eight years ago and recalls both Manu’s care for her and his theft from her till.
ep 7: Meher and Naina question Jitendra about the dawn phone borrower. He says the man remained outside Anardana Dhaba when his 6:20 bus departed and did not board it. Naina sends Bhuvan that narrower account, correcting an initial message that named Aadit.
ep 8: Aadit returns to Cedar Terrace and confirms that he borrowed Jitendra Rawat’s phone to call Meher. Bhuvan tells the family that the dead man is not Aadit, but remains unidentified. Meher insists that Aadit explain himself in front of Bhuvan.
ep 9: Bhuvan questions Aadit about the night of the fire. Aadit says he stayed in the orchard pump room after leaving the shed but refuses to name the person he went to meet. Meher conceals a paperback she wrote under a pen name whose plot resembles the apparent death of her husband.
ep 10: After Bhuvan and Aadit return from the orchard pump room, Meher questions how Aadit’s coat and ring reached the dead man. Aadit says he left his wedding ring in a blue biscuit tin before going to the shed.
